close_reason: Added UTCDate::new_validated() validation for all 3 sites in jmap-chat-server that accept client-supplied wire date strings: message.rs senderExpiresAt, invite.rs expiresAt, ban.rs expiresAt. Malformed values now emit invalidProperties rather than silently flowing into downstream string compares with undefined ordering. Added 3 new integration tests asserting rejection of malformed values. Sibling sites that produce server-side timestamps via now_utc_string() (space.rs, presence.rs, emoji.rs) remain unchanged as they generate well-formed values. All 96 chat-server tests pass. cargo clippy -p jmap-chat-server --all-targets -- -D warnings clean.
description:
Audit follow-up from JMAP-g7wu.9.5 — minor quality improvement, not a public API break.

Site: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs:375-391

Current code extracts senderExpiresAt as Option<String> from the JSON request value, then string-compares it to the current time via iso8601_before(). The string is never validated for RFC 3339 / UTCDate shape — a malformed value would silently pass the precondition check (iso8601_before would compare strings lexically, which works for some malformed forms and not others).

Improvement: parse the value via UTCDate::new_validated() and emit invalidProperties when the string is not a valid UTCDate. Internal-only refactor; no wire format change; no public API break.

Sibling sites (also use now_utc_string() then UTCDate::from() pattern) that may benefit from the same validation discipline if they parse incoming wire date strings:
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/invite.rs (now_utc_string usage)
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs (now_utc_string usage at lines 307, 608, 681)
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/presence.rs (line 188)
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/emoji.rs (line 360)
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/ban.rs (line 149)

Audit each: those that produce a server-side timestamp (UTCDate::from(now_utc_string().as_str())) are fine as-is. Only sites that accept a client-supplied date string need UTCDate::new_validated() validation.

This is P4 because the practical impact is small — clients producing malformed RFC 3339 strings are already broken in other ways — but it's the kind of input hygiene worth tidying up before publish.

Acceptance:
- All sites consuming client-supplied wire date strings parse via UTCDate::new_validated().
- Tests added for each: malformed senderExpiresAt etc. produces invalidProperties.
- cargo test -p jmap-chat-server passes.
- cargo clippy -p jmap-chat-server -- -D warnings clean.
title: Quality: validate sender_expires_at as UTCDate in jmap-chat-server message handler
